summary: Patch fixes the reported symptom by nulling `.axes` on children during cla(), but the linked issue explicitly asks to unset BOTH `.axes` and `.figure`, and only `.axes` is handled. Core reported behavior is resolved; the `.figure` half of the request is left incomplete.

issues.description: Issue title/body request that cla()/clf() unset both `.axes` AND `.figure` of deparented artists (mirroring remove(), which nulls both). Patch only sets `artist.axes = None`, leaving `.figure` still pointing at the figure — the fix is partial versus the stated requirement.

Directly assigning `artist.axes = None` on all get_children() (which includes spines, xaxis, yaxis, patch, title that are reused/recreated by __clear) is slightly blunt; relies on subsequent __clear reassigning them. Works given passing tests but is a bit fragile.
